# Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

We are committed to maintaining a respectful, inclusive, and professional environment for everyone who participates in this project.

## Expected Behaviour

Contributors should:

- Communicate respectfully and constructively.
- Welcome different viewpoints and levels of experience.
- Focus feedback on the work, not the person.
- Respect privacy, intellectual property, and project licensing.
- Avoid publishing personal, confidential, or sensitive information.

## Unacceptable Behaviour

The following are not acceptable:

- Harassment, discrimination, threats, or personal attacks.
- Deliberate disruption, spam, or abusive language.
- Sharing another person's private information without permission.
- Submitting malicious code, unsafe files, or intentionally misleading content.
- Any conduct that would reasonably make participation unsafe or hostile.

## Scope

This policy applies to repository discussions, issues, pull requests, reviews, and other spaces where someone is representing this project.

## Reporting

Report conduct concerns to the repository owner through the contact options available on the [GitHub profile](https://github.com/samusa099). Do not use a public issue when a report contains private or sensitive information. Security concerns must follow the process in `SECURITY.md`.

## Enforcement

The repository owner may edit or remove contributions, comments, issues, or other material that violates this policy. Repeated or serious violations may result in temporary or permanent restrictions from project participation.
